in_arabic.name: جَيْدَاء

in_english.name: Jaida
in_english.meaning: Jaida: a feminine given name, meaning virtuous, chaste, and devout

In modern times, Jaida has gained popularity as a given name in various Muslim cultures, symbolizing the virtues of a pious and devout woman.
